plugins.name: cpa-skills
plugins.description: 18 skills for accountants, tax professionals, controllers, and auditors. Every skill runs entirely on the local machine and refuses to deliver a workpaper that does not tie. Covers document extraction, bank and payroll and sales tax reconciliation, tax return review, K-1 footing, variance analysis, journal entry anomaly scanning, reproducible audit sampling, three-way match, fixed asset tie-out, AR aging, revenue tracing, indirect-method cash flow proof, expense and T&E policy testing, search for unrecorded liabilities, review of a reconciliation someone else prepared, and trial balance and chart of accounts integrity.
